content: September 21, 2024 Resources and Tools What to know Through, federal and state agencies, professional societies, and the Division of Laboratory System’s (DLS) work with other CDC programs international organizations, DLS supports the development and adoption of standards, guidelines, recommendations, and tools for improved quality and safety in clinical and public health laboratories. Background The following are useful resources to establish or strengthen biosafety practices in a clinical or public health laboratory.
